cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Investment in the Next Round
cards.instruction: Describe defeat, penalty, or a bad bargain as a deliberate investment in a larger future win.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Selling the stall at a loss was our investment in a better business. Get the margin sheet; I taught you to check costs before admiring the bunting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The mobile cart. No stall rent, and you finally know what that rent did to our takings. Price the cart for me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Put zero in the rent column, then work out how many lunches repay the loss. No guessing, like your first accounts; show me when this cart makes us more than the stall did.

reason: Dialogue-first reread correction: fix exact disclosure order or make the partner objection change the plan; remove excess lesson explanation while keeping the request and stated stakes.
